growth_signal.value: Raised a new funding round just seven months after the last one, going from a $96M Series C to a $1.8 billion valuation.

entry.idea: More people now ask AI chatbots for recommendations instead of searching the web, so Profound built tools that track and help improve how often a brand gets mentioned and recommended by AI answer engines.
entry.lesson: When a new kind of search takes off, build the measurement and optimization tools for it before anyone else does.
entry.name: Profound

growth.reason: Four funding rounds in about 15 months, each bigger than the last, taking it to a $1.8 billion valuation.

market.reason: As more people ask AI chatbots instead of using search engines, almost every brand worldwide that wants to be found could need a tool like this.

tech.reason: Building tools that track and influence how AI answer engines cite a brand is a real edge today, but competitors could copy the approach within a year or two.

entry.twist: It treats AI chatbots like a new kind of search engine, giving brands an 'SEO for AI' toolkit that also helps them research and create content AI systems are more likely to cite.
entry.who_pays: Marketing teams at brands pay to monitor and improve how they show up in AI-generated answers.
entry.why_now: As search shifts from typed queries to AI chat answers, brands need a new way to track and shape how AI describes and recommends them.
